headline: Made themes, staging, and deterministic run trust reproducible without overstating launch readiness.

items.title: Two real themes with hosted visual evidence
items.insight: Sewer Night and Porcelain Day are durable player preferences across HomeV2 and legal pages. The isolated preview passed 192 of 192 browser checks across 24 captures.

items.title: Inspectable deterministic run receipt
items.insight: The post-run analysis now shows the seed, named-stream draw counts, and a stable fingerprint from the live run. Copy explicitly distinguishes decision-stream evidence from full physics replay.

items.title: Executable closeout and isolated staging
items.insight: The repo now executes every named closeout helper through authoritative proxies. Bounded session branches deploy through the existing scoped CI secret, eliminating production-before-staging pressure.

validation: Full suite: 642/642 tests across 80 files; lint, build, public contract, protocol drift, replay fixtures, launch media, and launch QA passed.
Security release audit and npm audit passed with 0 vulnerabilities; working-tree and staged secret scans were clean.
Isolated staging deploy and brief-format workflows passed; 8/8 required routes returned 200 with CSP/nosniff.
Hosted visual matrix passed 192/192 machine checks across 24 captures; direct AI image inspection remains explicitly unclaimed after host CryptUnprotectData failures.
Studio doctor reports overallPass=true, failing=0, and blockingFailing=0.
followUps: Run physical PWA and controller QA.
Verify inbound email before changing contact delivery status.
Collect production Lighthouse and funnel evidence before HomeV1 retirement.
blockers: SPARKED remains NO-GO pending AI pixel review, physical, inbound-mail, production-data, publication, and founder evidence.
